description: Start here when picking up work: the live state of a repository, read from git and CI rather than from a handoff doc. Returns `summary` (one paragraph), `blockers` (most urgent first), the default branch's CI per workflow (red streak, since when, last green run), the build this Gluecron instance serves and how many commits it is behind (when it is this repository), every open PR grouped green / pending / failing / draft as the merge gate judges it, PRs merged in the last `merged_since_hours` (default 48), and the CI queue. Read-only.

merged_since_hours.description: Window for recently merged PRs (default 48, max 720)

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_handover
